}

}

  "engineer_id" INTEGER [not null]

}

  "engineer_visit_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "engineer_id" INTEGER [not null]

  "fault_status" TEXT [not null]
  "visit_start_datetime" TIMESTAMP
  "visit_end_datetime" TIMESTAMP
  "other_visit_details" TEXT
}

Table "Fault_Log" {
  "fault_log_entry_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "fault_description" TEXT
  "other_fault_details" TEXT
}

  "fault_log_entry_id" INTEGER [not null]

}

Table "Maintenance_Contracts" {
  "maintenance_contract_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "maintenance_contract_company_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "contract_start_date" TIMESTAMP
  "contract_end_date" TIMESTAMP
  "other_contract_details" TEXT
}

Table "Maintenance_Engineers" {
  "engineer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "company_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Part_Faults" {
  "part_fault_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "part_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "fault_short_name" TEXT
  "fault_description" TEXT
  "other_fault_details" TEXT
}

Table "Parts" {
  "part_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "part_name" TEXT
  "chargeable_yn" TEXT
  "chargeable_amount" TEXT
  "other_part_details" TEXT
}

Table "Skills" {
  "skill_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "skill_code" TEXT
  "skill_description" TEXT
}

Table "Skills_Required_To_Fix" {
  "part_fault_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "skill_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Staff" {
  "staff_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "staff_name" TEXT
  "gender" TEXT
  "other_staff_details" TEXT
}

Table "Third_Party_Companies" {
  "company_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "company_type" TEXT [not null]
  "company_name" TEXT
  "company_address" TEXT
  "other_company_details" TEXT
}
